Before ordering

Confirm the exact SKU, condition, seller, shipped components and support terms. Ask about memory module count, proprietary connectors and empty expansion slots. A PSU’s wattage or efficiency badge alone does not establish its suitability for a later GPU.

Current price and stock are not verified here. The researched specification summary is not a live inventory check or a measured performance review. Listing checked 2026-10-11; retailer pages can change.
